caption.en: Figure 51.1 — A deletion request follows every retained copy.
caption.zh-hans: 图 51.1：删除请求要追到每一份留存副本。

alt.en: Purpose-limited input reaches the model; credentials stay outside. Logs, memory, cache and feedback each remove the selected synthetic subject. A count-only receipt remains.
alt.zh-hans: 模型只收到符合用途的输入，凭据留在外部。日志、记忆、缓存和反馈分别删除指定虚构用户的数据，只留下计数回执。

credit.zh-hans: 原创教学图示 · CC BY-SA 4.0

flow.en: Field selection is a data-minimization control, not semantic detection of every secret.
flow.zh-hans: 字段筛选用于减少数据，不能识别任意文本中的所有秘密。

flow.en: Deleting these copies does not erase model weights or an unlisted backup.
flow.zh-hans: 删掉这些副本，不代表清除了模型参数或未列出的备份。
